quota_name: Number of accounts in a single OU quota
description: The maximum number of AWS Control Tower managed accounts that can be present in one OU. If you add accounts beyond this limit, the OU registration process in AWS Control Tower cannot be performed. To learn more about the number of accounts per OU, review Regions and Stackset Limitations in the AWS Control Tower documentation.
